footprint.derivation: chassis half extents; a backstop, strictly looser than the slip criterion at this geometry
footprint.quantity: load centre of mass projected into the deck plane leaves the chassis rectangle

separation.derivation: five control ticks; longer than a bounce during a hard stop, shorter than a sixth of a stop
separation.quantity: continuous time with no chassis_geom/load_geom contact, after at least one has been seen

slip.derivation: CHASSIS_HALF[0] - LOAD_HALF[0] = 0.40 - 0.25: the deck margin ahead of the seated load
slip.quantity: planar magnitude of the load's displacement relative to its seat

deck_grip_required.source: arithmetic on controller.py's published constants; controller.py was not edited

load_shed_rules.measured_in: chassis frame, relative to the load's seated position

severity_proxy.definition: magnitude of the load's world velocity minus the chassis's world velocity at the moment the first criterion fires

scene.load_attachment: free rigid body resting on the chassis deck, held by contact friction only
